scripts.build: bun run --cwd packages/contracts/ratified build && bun x tsc -b && bun run --cwd pwa build
scripts.check: bun run boundaries && bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run native:test
scripts.lint: bun run --cwd react-native lint && bun run --cwd apps/backend-worker lint && bun run --cwd pwa lint
scripts.test: bun run --cwd react-native test -- --runInBand && bun run --cwd apps/backend-worker test && bun run --cwd packages/contracts/ratified verify && bun run --cwd pwa test
scripts.typecheck: bun run build && bun run --cwd react-native typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/backend-worker typecheck && bun run --cwd pwa typecheck
